 Isle of Wight Festival 2027: Lineup Announcement Date, Ticket Presale & Rumours
 The wait is almost over for festival fans. Sky presents the Isle of Wight Festival 2027 is officially launching its ticket rollout, with the very first act announcements scheduled for Friday, 23rd October 2026 at 8:00 AM .
 Whether you are looking to secure priority presale passes or curious about who will follow in the footsteps of recent headliners, here is everything you need to know about ticket access, recent festival highlights, and line-up predictions for 2027.
 Important Dates & Ticket On-Sale Schedule
 To secure tickets before general release, PayPal customers get access to an exclusive 48-hour priority purchase window starting this Friday.
 PayPal Presale Opens 
 Friday, Oct 23, 2026 @ 08:00 AM 
First acts are announced at 8am. PayPal customers can buy tickets during a dedicated 48-hour window (ends Oct 25 at 7am or when sold out).
 PayPal Presale Closes 
 Sunday, Oct 25, 2026 @ 07:00 AM 
Priority presale window ends.
 General On-Sale Starts 
 Monday, Oct 26, 2026 @ 08:00 AM 
General ticket sale opens to the public at 8:00 AM.
 Looking Back: Standout Highlights from recent stages
 The festival has consistently brought together legendary headliners and breakthrough pop powerhouses at Seaclose Park. Recent editions featured an eclectic blend of indie rock legends and chart-topping superstars:
 Robbie Williams & Stereophonics: Delivered show-stopping main stage sets packed with arena-filling singalongs and British rock anthems.
 Kasabian: High-energy performances that turned the field into a massive indie rave.
 Becky Hill & Sugababes: Brought non-stop dance-pop hit lists, drawing some of the largest packed crowds of the weekend.
 Olivia Dean & Jamie Miller: Showcased soul-stirring vocal performances, underlining the festival’s focus on showcasing premier vocal talent alongside heritage acts.
 Line-up Speculation: Who Could Play in 2027?
 With the first acts dropping Friday at 8am, festival forums and fan speculation are already heating up. Here is what we might expect from the 2027 lineup strategy:
 1. The Heritage Rock Headliners
 Given the tradition of booking iconic stadium guitar bands (like previous hits Stereophonics and Kasabian), expectations are high for a massive indie or classic rock returning headliner to anchor Friday or Saturday night.
 2. Mainstream Pop & Dance Sensations
 Following the massive popularity of pop and dance sets from artists like Becky Hill and Sugababes, fans are speculating that 2027 will see another major UK pop queen or high-octane dance act in a prime sunset slot.
 3. Rising Stars & Soulful Vocals
 With breakout artists like Olivia Dean and Jamie Miller proving to be huge fan favourites, expect the 2027 bill to continue highlighting critically acclaimed UK vocalists and global streaming hits across the Big Top and Main Stage.
 How to Get Tickets
 PayPal Presale: Have your PayPal account logged in and ready before 8:00 AM on Friday, 23rd October . Presale tickets are available on a first-come, first-served basis and subject to status (18+).
 General Sale: Set your reminders for Monday, 26th October at 8:00 AM when remaining weekend, day, and camping tickets go live across major ticketing platforms.
 Subscribe to us and we will tell you the lineup once it’s confirmed.
